title: Fun Manhunt
description:
FPS - Things
Manhunt Compass
And some fun twists :)
Fun to play with friends
body:
Get ready for chaos, tension, and nonstop chases! This Manhunt Modpack turns your Minecraft world into a high-stakes pursuit game where one player runs for their life while others track them down using an upgraded compass system that constantly points to the target. But it’s not just vanilla manhunt — I added a few fun twists to keep every round unpredictable, from surprise events to gameplay modifiers that can flip the outcome in seconds.

Every match feels fresh, intense, and full of clutch moments, perfect for playing with friends who love competition and chaos. Whether you're the runner trying to outsmart everyone or the hunters coordinating the perfect chase, every second matters.

Download this modpack if you want faster, funnier, and more intense manhunt sessions that never feel the same twice. It’s simple to start, easy to understand, but hard to master — and that’s where the fun begins.
